security_concerns: native.rs append_tiff relocates pointer tag IDs regardless of containing IFD. Source ExifIFD tag 34853 LONG count=1 value=0x00100000 survives as ordinary tag, then relocation follows blob[p..], panicking. Reject directory pointers in unexpected groups or relocate only generated validated links. Add malformed input regression.

JPEG Extended XMP APP1 ignored. Person identities stored in extended packet do not reach for_export_with_person_source, leaving matching IPTC keywords copied into native/XMP under remove_person_info. Assemble bounded extensions or reject unsupported extended XMP rather than silently leaking. Regression with HasExtendedXMP and PersonInImage Alice plus IPTC Alice,Nature.
logic_errors: lib.rs metadata_packet image.metadata.or(native.xmp) means rating-only external sidecar discards all embedded copyright/contact/description/hierarchy under All and CopyrightOnly. Merge properties with sidecar overrides; add regression with embedded rights/hierarchy plus rating-only sidecar. Original-mode authoritative packet semantics need not change.
summary: Independent static review found native metadata panic, Extended XMP privacy bypass, and embedded metadata preservation loss. Must reproduce and fix before committing.
